items.description: Professional Linen, based in Hennopspark, has supplied quality linen to the medical profession and trade in South Africa for more than 30 years. The company sources its linen directly from trusted mills, prioritising fabric durability that can withstand hospital-grade washing, and says this direct-sourcing approach removes unnecessary intermediaries from its supply chain to enable direct delivery to customers. Its core customer base includes hospitals, institutions, doctors and physiotherapists, and it extends its range to clinics and homes and frail-care facilities. Professional Linen positions itself as a trusted linen partner for businesses and individuals seeking premium linen solutions, with a stated commitment to sustainability, innovation and continuous improvement across its product range and service. The business ships nationally within South Africa, meaning customers across the country, not only in the Centurion area where it is based, can access its medical and institutional linen ranges without needing a local supplier in every region.

Property Shop is a Pretoria-based estate agency that has been trading since it opened in the summer of 1990, giving it more than two decades of experience serving the Pretoria property market. Based in the Garsfontein area, the agency markets residential homes for sale and to let, along with commercial properties, mixed-use properties, smallholdings, vacant land and holiday lettings. Property Shop describes its agents as highly trained and motivated, and says it supports them with current technology, marketing strategies and client services, with a stated company policy of prioritising customer service. Beyond property sales and rentals, the agency offers tools such as property email alerts and online calculators for prospective buyers and tenants, publishes property news and maintains an active listings portfolio across the greater Pretoria area, including established suburbs such as Garsfontein.

PulseDroid Technology (Pty) Ltd, based in Centurion's Heritage Hill Estate, develops and operates Wherehouse, an e-commerce synchronisation platform aimed at South African businesses that sell across multiple online marketplaces. The product bridges sellers' marketplace accounts with their ERP or accounting systems, automatically syncing stock levels across channels to help prevent overselling or stale listings, and capturing orders directly into back-office systems. Wherehouse also provides a centralised analytics dashboard showing real marketplace fees and cost of goods sold so sellers can see true profitability per channel, together with a pricing-update tool that pushes price changes from a seller's own store or ERP to online marketplaces under customisable rules, and a buy-box repricing feature. An automated product-listing tool, available to brand owners and distributors on selected platforms, is also offered. The company describes itself as a trusted integration partner to a number of established South African brands selling through online marketplaces.

PXD Plastics, operating from Salieshoek in Silverton, Pretoria, is a plastic manufacturer and supplier of plastic sheeting solutions serving a wide range of South African industries. Its locally produced plastic products are used in construction, mining, bagging, tubing, the funeral trade, general-purpose applications, agriculture, retail and packaging. The company's product range includes greenhouse plastic, polythene sheets, rolls of plastic sheeting, durable rigid plastic sheets, waterproof sheeting and damp-proof membrane, offered in a range of thicknesses, sizes and colours to suit different client specifications. PXD Plastics holds SABS (South African Bureau of Standards) certification, meaning its products have undergone testing against recognised industry standards for quality and compliance. The company distributes beyond Pretoria, supplying customers across South Africa and into the broader African continent through its distribution network, positioning it as a supplier capable of serving both small-scale and larger industrial plastic sheeting needs.

rent-a-prop is a property rental and sales agency serving the greater Centurion and Pretoria East area. For landlords, the agency offers a tenant-screening process intended to help property owners find trustworthy occupants for their rental units. For prospective tenants, it helps match renters with homes suited to their family size and budget, covering both apartments and houses across areas such as Raslouw. The agency also runs a property email-alert service that notifies subscribers when new listings matching their search criteria become available, alongside standard tools for browsing current rental and for-sale stock online. Beyond transactions, rent-a-prop publishes periodic articles and tips for homeowners and tenants on its website. Based in the Heritage Hill Estate area of Centurion, the agency positions itself as a local point of contact for both residential letting and property sales in the surrounding suburbs.

Rickard Air Diffusion has operated in the HVAC industry since 1979, when it was established in Cape Town with a staff of only two; the company has since grown into a leading producer of variable air volume (VAV) diffusion equipment and controls, now serving clients internationally, including through a regional presence in Pretoria. Its core specialism is VAV diffusers, which are HVAC outlets that precisely regulate the volume of air delivered to a space to match occupant demand, helping to save energy while communicating with a building's management system (BMS) for centralised control. Around this core product, Rickard Air Diffusion supplies a range of add-on equipment including heater banks, pressure- and temperature-control dampers, fire dampers, supply and return air grilles, top-up heating elements, occupancy and airflow sensors, BMS gateways and air handling unit (AHU) zone controllers. The company remains privately owned and is managed directly by its shareholders, with a stated mission of serving the air-conditioning industry with energy-efficient, flexible and reliable air diffusion solutions for commercial buildings.

Roadchem supplies road and surface maintenance products from its premises on the corner of Charl Avenue and Milfoil Road in Kameeldrift West, Pretoria West. Its product range includes cold asphalt used for pothole repair, crack sealant for repairing surface cracks before they widen, roof sealant, seal coat treatments and slurry surfacing products, with technical datasheets available for each product line. The company serves customers involved in road, driveway and general surface maintenance and repair, supplying the materials needed to patch, seal and resurface both tarred roads and other paved or roofed surfaces. Being based on the western side of Pretoria gives Roadchem convenient reach to surrounding industrial and residential developments that require ongoing road and surface upkeep.

Robotic Steelworks manufactures and supplies a broad range of steel and aluminium products from its premises on Hendrik van Eck Street in Rosslyn, Akasia. Its product range covers palisade, designer and Clearview fencing, razor wire, gates and wall extensions for security purposes, alongside structural steelwork and balustrades. The company also manufactures trailers and supplies aluminium windows and doors, as well as roller shutter garage doors, giving it a presence across both the security fencing and broader steel fabrication markets. Operating from the Rosslyn industrial area places Robotic Steelworks within reach of the wider Akasia and northern Pretoria industrial and residential developments that it supplies with fencing, gates and structural steel products. The business handles both manufacturing and installation of its product range for commercial and residential clients.

Roux van Rooyen Accounting Inc began in 1994 as a small practice working from home with only a handful of clients, and has since grown into a larger firm operating from its own premises in Magalieskruin, employing staff across multiple areas of finance. The practice has now operated for more than two decades, serving business entities of varying sizes throughout Southern Africa, and maintains contact with both local and international auditing and accounting firms to keep pace with industry developments. Its service range covers accounting, auditing, payroll management and payroll training, taxation, and VAT administration, aimed at keeping client businesses compliant with statutory financial requirements. The firm holds accreditation with the South African Institute of Professional Accountants (SAIPA) and the Independent Regulatory Board for Auditors (IRBA, previously PAAB), and operates as a Sage Business Partner, reflecting its focus on using established accounting software and standards in its client work.

SA Baking Supplies trades from 262 Cradock Street in Lyttelton, Centurion, as one of several branches the retailer operates across South Africa. The Lyttelton store stocks baking ingredients, cake-decorating items and other baking-related products for home bakers and small businesses. It keeps extended weekday trading hours from Monday to Friday, with shorter Saturday hours, and remains closed on Sundays and public holidays. As part of a multi-branch chain that also trades in locations such as Centurion's Lifestyle Centre, Edenvale and George, the Lyttelton branch gives customers in the Kloofsig and wider Centurion area local access to a dedicated baking-supplies retailer without needing to travel to one of the chain's other branches.

SA Hunt Training operates from the premises of the SA Hunters and Game Conservation Association (SAHGCA) at Mountain Drive 7, Plot 3, Derdepoort, Roodeplaat. The association describes itself as a representative voice for hunting, sport shooting, firearm ownership and sustainable conservation in South Africa, supporting members in meeting the legal requirements to own and use a firearm and representing members' interests in relevant national forums and legal processes. Its structure includes dedicated Hunting and Shooting committees alongside a Conservation Committee, and it provides members with information on hunting licences, proclamations and game-transport permits as part of its hunter-education role. The association also runs the HuntEx exhibition and an SA Hunters Shop for members. Being based at the association's Derdepoort premises, SA Hunt Training forms part of a members' organisation involved in legal advocacy work, including bringing legal challenges on hunting and wildlife-related legislation before South African courts.

Sagario Branding, based in De Wilgers, Pretoria, supplies branded promotional products across categories including gifting, display items, hampers, clothing, headwear and workwear. The company offers in-house branding capability, meaning it can apply a client's logo or design directly to a wide range of products rather than relying on third-party branding contractors, covering everything from corporate gifts to custom apparel. Customers can place orders and pay via EFT, with delivery costs calculated after checkout based on the client's location and the size and weight of the order. Sagario Branding also offers what it describes as virtual support, giving clients real-time assistance with placing orders, tracking deliveries and selecting suitable branded products. The business positions itself as a supplier that helps other companies strengthen their brand visibility through consistent, practical promotional merchandise rather than one-off novelty items.

Samarina (Pty) Ltd, based on Paul Kruger Street in Mayville, Pretoria, operates in the retail, sales and health and wellness sectors, with a focus on helping customers improve their everyday lifestyle through natural wellness products. Its featured product is IASO Detox Tea, a herbal tea the company markets as supporting digestive wellness, healthy lifestyle goals and gentle, everyday cleansing, with secondary claims around supporting weight-management goals. The company delivers its wellness products to customers nationwide across South Africa rather than limiting sales to its Pretoria base, and promotes its offering as a calm, natural alternative within the wellness-product market. Samarina positions itself as a South African wellness company rather than a manufacturer, focusing on sourcing and distributing herbal products it considers gentle and effective for daily use.

Savignac (Pretoria) Pty Ltd forms the Pretoria-based inland arm of Savignac, a South African company that creates, owns and distributes its own registered hardware brands: SAVI EURO, SAVI AFRIQ and SAVI EQUINOX. The company structures its operations with inland and coastal divisions based in Pretoria and Cape Town respectively, and its finance function based in KwaZulu-Natal. Its product range covers aluminium window and door hardware and components, including hinges, spring-loaded and thumbturn door handles, latchlocks, hooklocks, deadlocks, profile cylinders, bottom rollers and a pet-resistant heavy-duty screen sold under its SAVI EURO, SAVI AFRIQ and SAVI EQUINOX ranges, spanning budget, value and premium price tiers. By owning its brands outright rather than reselling third-party hardware, Savignac supplies both inland and coastal markets across South Africa and Sub-Saharan Africa from its Derdepoort-area Pretoria base.

Senhor Peri Peri Midstream is a branch of the Senhor Peri Peri chain, an eatery specialising in Portuguese-style peri-peri chicken, trading from Square @ Midstream in Midstream Estate, Olifantsfontein. The brand promotes its own ordering app, which lets customers order ahead and collect their food at standard menu prices while skipping the in-store queue, positioning this as a way to avoid the extra charges sometimes added by third-party delivery platforms. Senhor Peri Peri also operates as a franchise, with multiple stores trading under the same name and menu across South Africa. Customer feedback referenced on the brand's own site describes the food at its stores as fresh and the service as friendly and consistent. As a Midstream Estate location, the restaurant serves residents and visitors to the Midstream area looking for a quick peri-peri chicken meal either to eat in or collect.

Servco is a business based in Waterkloof Park, Pretoria, operating under three named divisions according to its own website. ServCo Premium Bars provides bar services, fitting with the broader events and function-venue space in which the company is listed. A second division, ServCo Asset Solutions, operates alongside it, while a planned ServCo Creative Agency division is described on the company's site as still in development rather than active. This suggests a business built initially around bar and asset-related services that is in the process of expanding into creative and brand-related work as a further division. Operating from the established Waterkloof Park area gives Servco convenient reach into Pretoria's eastern suburbs, where it can support local events, functions and venues needing bar services.

Shelf Company For Sale Pretoria operates as an online marketplace selling pre-registered shelf companies to businesses across the Pretoria and wider South African market. The company positions itself as a fully online, eCommerce-based shelf company provider rather than requiring walk-in appointments, processing orders around the clock with its stated operating model built around remote service delivery. It says every shelf company it sells comes with a free director change, together with address and company name changes, and promotes same-day director changes so that buyers can begin trading immediately after purchase. The business also assists buyers in opening a bank account for their newly acquired shelf company and offers optional add-ons such as VAT and tax clearance registration. The company states it has served more than 10,000 clients to date, reflecting a business built around high-volume, standardised company-registration transactions rather than bespoke company formation services.

Signarama Pretoria North is a branch of the Signarama signage franchise serving businesses in the Boekenhoutskloof and wider Pretoria North area. The branch offers concept-to-completion signage services, managing projects from initial design through to manufacture and installation rather than handling only one part of the process. Its product range spans A-frames and metal signs, 3D lettering, illuminated signs, billboards, vehicle signage, shop signage, promotional outdoor signage, indoor signage, wayfinding signage, wall and building signs, bakkie (vehicle) signage and exhibition signage, giving it a broad base of signage types it can produce for a single client. As a project-managed signage provider, the branch oversees each job internally rather than outsourcing stages to third parties, with its own team positioned as the local point of contact for signage and branding needs in the Pretoria North area throughout a project's life.

Signworks is a sign manufacturer based in the Koedoespoort Industrial area of Pretoria, describing itself as one of the country's leading sign-making businesses. The company offers full graphic and branding services, including logo design, alongside its core manufacturing work, handling signage projects from initial concept through to completion. Its 3D fabricated signage is produced from materials including acrylic, vacuum-formed plastic and wood, giving clients a range of options depending on budget and the intended application of the sign. Signworks is a member of the International Sign Association and describes itself as owner-managed, with hands-on involvement in day-to-day operations rather than operating through layers of management. The company says it services all areas rather than limiting itself to the immediate Pretoria area, and works by appointment, aiming to handle signage and design needs for clients under one roof rather than outsourcing parts of the process.

Simplex Group is a multi-disciplinary consulting firm operating predominantly across Sub-Saharan Africa from its base in Lyttelton Manor, Centurion. Its main areas of practice include labour law, immigration matters, criminal and forensic investigations, insurance claims assessments, fraud-risk reviews and awareness training, compliance reviews, and general legal consulting. Rather than keeping all services in-house permanently, the firm's business model relies on engaging an extensive network of professionals and associates as needed, allowing it to scale resources up or down depending on each client assignment's requirements. Simplex Group describes itself as a boutique firm with a national infrastructure and professionally trained and qualified staff, offering clients negotiable and flexible fee structures rather than fixed standard rates. The firm positions itself as aiming to be a leading, recognised professional consulting company both within South Africa and internationally, drawing on practical experience across labour, immigration, insurance, fraud and compliance matters for a range of client types.

Sircony SA was incorporated in 1995 as South Africa's first BEE-owned manufacturer, importer and exporter of cabling and electronic components, and the company says it has built more than 30 years of combined experience in this role within the local market. Its global affiliate network uses machinery intended to meet production demands and holds ISO 9001 certification, with Sircony stating that its products undergo rigorous testing under strict quality-control conditions before reaching customers. The company's product range, sold from its Sunderland Ridge base in Centurion, spans audio-visual and HDMI cabling, TV and satellite plugs, sockets and adaptors, antennas, contact cleaners, switches, and telephone accessories, positioning it as a general electronic-accessory supplier rather than a specialist in any single category. Sircony SA says it keeps its pricing as low as the market allows without compromising on the quality or reliability of its components.

SMW Consultants, based in Sinoville, Pretoria, assists clients experiencing financial hardship by coordinating with a network of legal specialists experienced in debt-related matters. The firm's team says it has many years of experience in this field and works to maintain client trust and privacy while advising on options for resolving difficult debt situations. SMW Consultants assists clients throughout all provinces of South Africa rather than limiting its service to Gauteng. Its stated practice areas cover sequestration, where an application before the High Court can result in a person being relieved of their debts once accepted, with no creditor able to demand further payment; liquidation, aimed at close corporation members or company directors whose entities can no longer continue trading; and rehabilitation, which allows a previously insolvent individual to apply to resume a stable financial life. The firm positions itself as a practical first point of contact for people and businesses facing insolvency-related decisions.

Somakhawula Language Consultancy provides translation, editing, proofreading and interpreting services covering South Africa's official languages, additional foreign languages and sign language. Beyond language services, the consultancy also offers design and layout work, including branding, corporate identity, web design and new-media design, alongside copywriting services that it describes as aiming to capture and hold an audience's attention. The business, associated with an address in Sunnyside, Pretoria, states that it operates according to a set of core values covering quality management, teamwork and networking, problem solving, and honesty and integrity in its client dealings. By combining language services with design and copywriting under one roof, Somakhawula positions itself as able to support clients with both the linguistic and visual-communication sides of reaching audiences across South Africa's different language groups.

Spaceweb Technologies is a Pretoria-based consultancy, operating from Wonderboom South, that focuses on helping small and medium businesses streamline their day-to-day operations. The company says it analyses a client's existing workflows to identify operational bottlenecks before proposing tailored solutions, whether that means improving employee productivity or integrating more advanced technology into daily processes. Alongside this operational consulting, Spaceweb Technologies offers business-analysis services aimed at helping clients identify opportunities for growth and efficiency within their existing operations. It also designs websites for clients, describing its approach as building visually appealing, user-friendly sites intended to capture an audience and support online conversions. Together, these services position the company as a combined operations consultant and web-design provider for smaller Pretoria-area businesses looking to modernise both their internal processes and their online presence.

SpecCon Holdings was established in 2013 and has grown from a single employee to a workforce of more than 150, with the company noting that over half of its current staff came through its own learnership programmes, with a number of them now in management roles. SpecCon describes its own evolution as moving from an Excel-training business into one of South Africa's leading providers of learnerships, QCTO-aligned qualifications, learning-management-system training and online courses, now operating from six offices across the country rather than a single site. Its service range extends beyond direct training to include B-BBEE solutions, skills-development solutions, employment-equity solutions, and POPIA, PAIA and CPA compliance support for client businesses, alongside standardised assessments such as basic Excel, typing, literacy and mathematical skills tests. Based in Kloofsig, Lyttelton Manor, the company positions its growth story and internal promotion of former learners as central to how it presents itself to prospective learnership participants and corporate clients alike.

items.description: Squeaky Clean Window & Solar Panel Cleaners, based in Boardwalk Manor, provides professional window-cleaning and solar-panel-cleaning services to both residential and commercial customers. For residential clients, the company focuses on general window cleaning, aiming to leave glass surfaces clear enough that customers can barely tell the window is there. Its solar-panel-cleaning service is aimed at helping rooftop solar installations continue working at their full potential, on the basis that dirt and debris buildup on panels can reduce their efficiency over time. For commercial customers, the business says it carries a wide range of equipment suited to different building types and window-cleaning needs. The company offers a free assessment or quote for prospective customers before carrying out any cleaning work, allowing clients to understand the scope and cost of a job in advance.

StitchOn provides embroidery and clothing-production services from its base in Waverley, Pretoria, focusing on corporate and workwear solutions for businesses. The company produces corporate branded clothing intended to promote a client's company brand through consistent use of logos and colours across staff uniforms and workwear. As part of its embroidery service, StitchOn's in-house design team can digitise an existing image or company logo into a digitised embroidery file ready for production. The business says its embroidery machines can then create high-quality, long-lasting embroidered logos within minutes, with finishes designed to resist fading and peeling over repeated wear and washing compared with some printed alternatives. StitchOn offers no-obligation quotes to prospective clients ahead of placing an order, allowing businesses to assess pricing for bulk corporate clothing orders before committing to a production run.

Stor-Age Self Storage Centurion, located on Theron Street in Lyttelton, offers personal, business, student and vehicle self-storage across more than 40 different unit sizes, allowing customers to rent a unit for as little as a single month rather than committing to a long-term lease. The facility's access hours run from 07:00 to 18:00 on weekdays and 08:00 to 17:00 on weekends, with a separate, shorter office-hours schedule for in-person enquiries and payments. Alongside storage units, the branch sells packaging materials such as boxes for customers preparing to move or store their belongings, and offers a van rental service to help customers transport items to and from their unit. The branch also provides a parcel-collection service, allowing customers expecting deliveries they cannot receive at home to have packages delivered to the storage facility for later collection.

Stor-Age Self Storage Zwartkop, located on Migmatite Drive in Zwartkop, Pretoria, offers personal and business self-storage across more than 40 different unit sizes, with the flexibility to rent a unit for as little as one month. Access hours run from 07:00 to 18:00 on weekdays and 08:00 to 17:00 on weekends, with a separate, shorter set of office hours for walk-in enquiries. The facility sells packaging materials such as storage boxes for customers who need supplies for a move or for packing items before storage, and offers a van rental service to help customers transport belongings to and from their unit. Stor-Age Zwartkop also provides a parcel-collection service, allowing customers who are not available to receive a delivery at home to have it sent to the facility and collected later at their convenience.

items.description: Tailor-Made Risk Solutions, trading as T-MRS from Fish Eagle Drive in Sable Hills Waterfront Estate, Roodeplaat, supplies industrial absorbent and degreaser products alongside its core risk-management consulting work. The company states its mission is to provide sustainable, tailor-made and cost-effective risk solutions designed to meet each customer's specific requirements, rather than offering a single standardised package. It describes its approach as built on three stated values: trust, aiming for solid business relationships based on honesty; integrity, conducting business with humility; and quality, supplying customers with products and services it considers superior. The combination of physical absorbent and degreaser products with risk-management advisory services allows Tailor-Made Risk Solutions to support clients on both the practical, on-site spill- and contamination-control side of risk management and the broader consulting side of identifying and managing operational risk.

items.description: Tech Smart Business Solutions, based in Zwavelpoort, Pretoria, supplies technology solutions to businesses on a flexible monthly-rental basis rather than requiring large upfront capital outlay. Its offering spans three main areas: solar energy solutions, covering installation and ongoing maintenance of solar panel systems aimed at reducing a client's energy costs and carbon footprint; CCTV security systems, including installation, monitoring and maintenance services intended to protect business premises and assets; and telephone and communication systems, covering modern business telephony intended to improve connectivity and customer service. By offering all three categories on a rental model, the company positions itself as a way for businesses to access solar, security and communication infrastructure while preserving their cash flow, rather than needing to purchase and maintain the underlying equipment themselves.

Techtion is an automation specialist based in Rosslyn, Pretoria, providing turnkey automation solutions and services to clients in the automotive, food and beverage, and tobacco industries. The company's core automation and systems work covers in-house programmable logic controller development, as well as the improvement of new and existing production systems, delivered on a turnkey basis so clients receive a complete working solution rather than individual components. Alongside this, Techtion offers programming and software support across a range of different software platforms, tailoring its approach to each client's specific production environment. Its engineering division provides product design and development, engineering consulting, and ongoing support and training for client staff, positioning the company as a single point of contact spanning automation hardware, software and the engineering expertise needed to implement and maintain production systems in industrial settings.

Texican Willows is a Mexican-themed eatery and bar trading from the Willows Crossing Shopping Centre in The Willows, Pretoria. The restaurant describes its focus as tasty, fresh cuisine served in a homely bar setting, with regular specials offered alongside its standard menu. Its food range spans burgers and grills through to classic Mexican dishes such as tacos and enchiladas, giving it a menu that blends American-style grill items with more traditional Mexican fare. The restaurant has refreshed its menu over time while keeping its established Mexican favourites available for returning customers. Texican Willows trades seven days a week, with longer hours on weekdays and Saturdays than on Sundays, making it a dine-in option for shoppers and residents in and around The Willows area of Pretoria.

items.description: The Nut Factory, based in Erasmia, Pretoria, built its business around cashew nuts, describing itself as a large importer of cashew nuts sourced from within Africa. Beyond its core cashew range, the retailer sells a broad selection of roasted and flavoured nuts, including mixed nuts, macadamia nuts and sugar-coated peanuts, alongside dried fruit products such as mango and other fruit slices. Its product categories extend into general cooking and baking ingredients, seeds, snacks, lunchbox treats, sweet snacks and gifting ranges, positioning the business as a broad nut and dried-fruit retailer covering many categories rather than specialising narrowly in one product line. Customers can buy products loose or in gift-oriented packaging, making The Nut Factory a destination both for everyday snacking supplies and for gift purchases built around nuts and dried fruit.

items.description: The Rescue Company, based in Nieuw Muckleneuk, Pretoria, provides business rescue, informal turnaround management and consultation services for companies and close corporations experiencing financial distress. Business rescue is a formal process available under South African company law for entities in financial distress, while informal turnaround management instead seeks an out-of-court settlement between a company and its creditors aimed at reducing its overall indebtedness without going through formal proceedings. The company also offers consultation services, advising clients on whether business rescue or liquidation is the more appropriate path given their circumstances. It defines financial distress in line with the Companies Act as a situation where a company appears reasonably unlikely to pay all its debts as they fall due within the next six months, or appears reasonably likely to become insolvent within that period. The Rescue Company points to warning signs such as ongoing cashflow shortages, difficulty paying or negotiating with creditors, reduced demand for a company's products or services, staff retrenchments, an overdraft running at capacity, and management or ownership disputes causing financial losses, as indicators that a business should seek this kind of help.

Timeless Journey (Pty) Ltd is a creative agency based in Amberfield, Centurion, offering graphic design, website development, corporate branding and social media management as a combined set of services for business clients. Its design work covers logo design, email signature design, flyer and poster design, and advert design for both digital and print platforms, together with social media graphics intended to keep a client's visual branding consistent across channels. On the web side, the agency builds responsive, mobile-friendly websites designed to reflect a client's brand and engage visitors, with services extending to custom website design, e-commerce functionality and ongoing website maintenance after a site goes live. By offering design, branding, web development and social media management together, Timeless Journey positions itself as a single long-term creative partner for businesses rather than a provider of one-off design jobs.

TOPS at SPAR The Hill is a liquor store on Albertus Street in La Montagne, Pretoria, attached to the Lanos Spar Shopping Centre. Directory listings categorise the store as a liquor store, beer store, soft drinks shop and wine store, reflecting a stock range that covers wines, spirits, beer and soft drinks for customers shopping at the attached supermarket. The store keeps extended trading hours on most days, opening from 08:00 to 20:00 Monday through Saturday, with shorter Sunday hours from 09:00 to 15:00 in line with South African liquor-trading regulations. As a SPAR-linked liquor outlet, TOPS at SPAR The Hill allows shoppers in the La Montagne area to buy liquor products alongside their regular grocery shopping at the same shopping centre.

TOPS at SPAR Wierda Park is a liquor store at 402 Theuns van Niekerk Street in Centurion's Wierda Park area, attached to the Wierda 2 Shopping Centre. As part of the TOPS at SPAR chain, the store stocks a standard range of wines, spirits and beer alongside the adjoining SPAR supermarket. It trades six days a week with shorter Sunday hours, opening from 09:00 to 20:00 on weekdays, 08:00 to 20:00 on Saturdays, and 09:00 to 14:00 on Sundays, in line with South African liquor-trading rules. The branch is one of several TOPS at SPAR outlets operating across the greater Centurion area, giving shoppers in Wierda Park a nearby liquor option alongside their regular grocery shop at the attached supermarket.
